cases.title: Group message signed by the parent domain, strict DMARC
cases.explanation: A real-world pattern (found on an authorised university message): a group sends as lists.acme.example but signs with acme.example, and acme.example publishes DMARC with adkim=s. Strict alignment cannot match a subdomain, so DMARC cannot be confirmed from DKIM alone, although the message is genuine. Not cleared: the engine abstained on a legitimate message.
